title: Complete B3 slope-policy characterization with the independently qualified local corrector slope

policy.name: E4_B3_CORRECTOR_JR
policy.reanchor_rule: retain this HCOF and update only RHS to pass through each accepted real-SWAP corrector point

gates: E4_B3_CORRECTOR_JR converges within 40 coupling outer iterations without changing SWAP or MODFLOW tolerances.
Exactly one SWAP candidate and one interface ledger entry are committed.
Accepted head differs from the fixed CURRENT_PLUS_U control by <=5e-10 m.
Accepted q_swap differs from the fixed CURRENT_PLUS_U control by <=2e-15 m/s.
Accepted ledger differs from the fixed CURRENT_PLUS_U control by <=2e-13 m.
characterization_only: outer iteration count relative to CURRENT_PLUS_U=3
interpretation_rules: A MAP05A pass does not rescue MAP05: INTERCEPT_ONLY remains a preregistered failure.
If MAP05A converges to the same accepted physics, report that the independently measured negative corrector slope is admissible in this B3 case.
If MAP05A changes work, report only this one-case numerical observation; do not generalize performance.
If MAP05A fails its corrector domain, retain the failure and stop before any production change.
forbidden: no claim that J_R should replace u_A in production from this single case
